main_measure.name: |forecast|-weighted mean excess gain of the short over holding, 10 bars, non-overlapping, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm if > 0 with t >= 2; reject if < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; fewer than 30 cases inconclusive

supporting_check.name: top minus bottom tercile of |forecast|, weighted mean short excess gain

decided_by: The t-statistic lies strictly between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Holding is the coin's mean of all overlapping 10-bar forward returns over all its windows, the short's excess gain is -(forward return - holding), cases are bars 0,10,20,... of each window with forecast < 0, the t uses a weighted-mean standard error sqrt(sum w^2 (x-m)^2 * n/(n-1)) / sum w, and terciles are equal-count thirds of the pooled cases ranked by |forecast|, compared by their |forecast|-weighted means.
